h1: Suvarnabhumi Ville Airport Hotel — Sleep Near BKK Airport, Shuttle Included Before Your Flight
intro: If you have an early-morning departure or a late-night arrival at Suvarnabhumi and want a worry-free bed close to the airport, Suvarnabhumi Ville Airport Hotel is a name travellers mention again and again. This 4-star, 145-room hotel sits in the King Kaeo area of Racha Thewa, Bang Phli — about a 10-minute drive from the terminals, with a 24-hour shuttle, an outdoor pool, a rooftop restaurant and free parking. Rooms start from approx. ฿850/night, and it holds an 8.8 score from over 1,300 real guest reviews on Trip.com.

body.html: The main reason people choose Suvarnabhumi Ville is its location near Suvarnabhumi Airport and its shuttle service. The hotel sits in the King Kaeo area of Racha Thewa, about a 10-minute drive from the terminals, with an airport shuttle running 24 hours a day (surcharge applies; bookable in advance). That makes a real difference for anyone flying out before dawn or landing late at night — no scrambling for a ride.

What sets it apart from a plain transit hotel is the level of facilities you get at this price. There's an outdoor swimming pool, a fitness centre, a spa and sauna, two restaurants plus a cafe, and a rooftop restaurant that guests praise for its views. It suits travellers who don't just want a place to crash, but a proper stay for a night or two before or after a journey.

Rooms range from the Deluxe Room and Premier Pool Access to Executive Rooms with pool views and the Premier Suite. Guests consistently praise the clean rooms, comfortable beds and fresh, modern decor — the hotel only opened in 2016. Many rooms have a private balcony, a coffee maker and good toiletries. The Pool Access rooms let you step straight down to the pool, and they're an upgrade plenty of people happily pay for.

"Landed late at night, called the hotel for a pickup and it was easy — clean room, comfortable bed, and a car back to the airport in time for our flight. Genuinely worth it for sleeping near Suvarnabhumi."

The first thing to keep in mind is that the airport shuttle carries a charge and can have a wait at busy times. It isn't a free service like at some dedicated airport hotels, and during peak hours you may have to wait for the next run. Book or confirm your pickup time with the hotel in advance — especially for very early flights — and leave yourself enough margin.

The other point reviewers raise is occasional inconsistency in cleanliness and service at busy periods. Most guests praise the clean rooms and friendly staff, but a few have found small details overlooked or slower service when the hotel is full. The King Kaeo area is also car-dependent — there aren't many restaurants or shops within walking distance, so if you want to eat out you'll need a ride.

Overall, Suvarnabhumi Ville holds an 8.8 out of 10 on Trip.com from over 1,300 real guest reviews — high for an airport-area hotel. It's a well-judged choice for anyone flying in and out of Suvarnabhumi who wants to stay close in comfort, with a pool and restaurants on site. Prices start around ฿850 and climb with the season and room type into the mid-thousands for Pool Access rooms or suites. If you can accept the shuttle fee and a location that needs a car, it offers strong value among airport hotels.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Suvarnabhumi Ville Airport Hotel

faq.q: How close is Suvarnabhumi Ville to Suvarnabhumi Airport, and is there a shuttle?
faq.a: The hotel is in the King Kaeo area of Racha Thewa, Bang Phli, about a 10-minute drive to the Suvarnabhumi Airport terminals. There's a 24-hour airport shuttle (surcharge applies) — give the hotel your flight time and book it in advance.

faq.q: How much does Suvarnabhumi Ville cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start from approx. ฿850/night for a Deluxe Room. Options range from Deluxe and pool-view Executive rooms to Premier Pool Access and the Premier Suite. Rates climb with the season and room type into the mid-thousands — always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Suvarnabhumi Ville have a pool and parking?
faq.a: Yes to both. There's an outdoor swimming pool, a fitness centre, a spa and free parking. The Premier Pool Access rooms let you step straight down to the pool — a point real reviews praise often.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Suvarnabhumi Ville — are they clean?
faq.a: Rooms have fresh, modern decor as the hotel only opened in 2016. Most reviews praise the clean rooms and comfortable beds, with many offering a balcony and coffee maker. Cleanliness can be slightly inconsistent at busy times, but the overall cleanliness score sits around 8.7.

faq.q: Who is Suvarnabhumi Ville best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for anyone flying in or out of Suvarnabhumi — pre-dawn departures, late arrivals, or a comfortable stay before or after a trip — with a shuttle, pool and free parking. Because the King Kaeo area is car-dependent, it's less suited to those who want to walk to sights or restaurants.
Rooms are generally quiet enough, but some may catch aircraft or King Kaeo road noise. If you're a light sleeper, ask for a higher floor or a room away from the road for a quieter night.
